name: smwmusic-super-mario-world-way-of-the-koopa-madness-fortress-remix
title: Super Mario World - Way Of The Koopa ~ Madness Fortress (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Madness Fortress, which is a remix of the SMW Castle theme by Holy Order Sol (It's a REMIXCEPTION!!!). It's been a decade since this song was uploaded, and I really really REALLY wanted to arrange this song for a long time now, especially after being somewhat motivated by Wakana's version (which is just amazing! Go listen to it if you haven't already).

Madness Fortress is a really great take on the castle theme with a more sinister / medieval vibe than the original song, almost making this sound completely different.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F# Minor (Wakana Pitch)
